# AI Index Optimizer

> AI Index Optimizer audits whether AI assistants can reach, read and cite a website, then ships the crawler rules, llms.txt, schema and metadata fixes that make a page quotable in AI answers.

## What this site is
A free AI visibility audit for any domain with per-provider results for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, plus copy-paste fix files. Paid plans start at $39 per month for three domains.

## Brand mark
The mark reads AIO. The A and the O are geometric capitals and the I is a magnifying glass with a lime lens rim, off-white on ink navy. This is the official logo as of 18 November 2026 and supersedes the earlier icon.

## Key pages
- https://ai-index-optimizer.com/ : product overview and how the scan works
- https://ai-index-optimizer.com/geo-audit : free AI visibility audit
- https://ai-index-optimizer.com/pricing : Starter $39/mo 3 domains, Growth $99/mo 10, Agency $299/mo 30
